question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Desiccate
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'Hydrate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Desiccate"** means to remove the moisture from something, typically in order to preserve it.
 
• It comes from the **Latin word "desiccare"** which** means 'to make dry'**.(सूखा हुआ)
 
• The word that is **opposite in meaning **to **"Desiccate**" is "**Hydrate".**
 
• **"Hydrate" **means to cause to absorb water or moisture, or to become more hydrated.(पानी से भरना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Hydrate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Honour"** means to regard with great respect or to fulfill an obligation or keep an agreement. (सम्मान)
 
• "**Ascend" **means to go up or climb. (चढ़ना)
 
• **"Venerate" **means to regard with great respect; revere.(आदर करना)
